in_sanskrit.name: Appi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mother's lap
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Appi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word आपि (Apī), meaning 'to sit on the lap of'. In Hindu mythology, Appi can refer to the divine mother Goddess, signifying protection and nurturing.

in_hindi.name: आमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mother, the giver of life and nurturer, the one who provides comfort and protection, the embodiment of love and selflessness.
